tei:div.tei:p:
He is compassionate, grants atonement for guilt and does not destroy; many a time does He avert His anger nor does He arouse the whole of His wrath. Thou, O Lord, dost not withold Thy compassion from me, Thy grace and Thy truth always protect me. Remember Thy compassion, O Lord, and Thine acts of kindness for they are from eternity. Ascribe might to God,
over Israel is His supremacy and His might is in the skies. Awe-inspiring art Thou, O God, from Thy sanctuary the God of Israel. He gives might and strength to the people, blessed be God. God of vengeance is the Lord, O God of vengeance, appear. Arise, O Judge of the earth, render retribution to the proud. Salvation is the Lord's, may Thy blessing come upon Thy people (Selah). The Lord of Hosts is with us, a refuge for us is the God of Jacob (Selah). Lord of Hosts, fortunate the man who trusts in Thee. O Lord, save; may the King answer us on the day we call.
